newsitem.title: USA: Solectron to acquire Force Computers.
newsitem.headline: Solectron to acquire Force Computers.

text.p: Solectron Corp. will acquire Force Computers Inc., another manufacturer of products for the electronics industry, for about $187.5 million, they said Thursday.
The companies said the merger will greatly improve their manufacturing capability and flexibility in meeting customers' needs.
San Jose, Calif.-based Force, a major designer and manufacturer of computer systems, will become a subsidiary of Solectron.
Solectron, based in Milpitas, Calif., provides manufacturing services to electronics companies worldwide.
No other terms of the transaction were disclosed.
The merger is expected to close in early November, subject to regulatory approvals.
Solectron's stock rose 87.5 cents to $48.75 early on the New York Stock Exchange.
